request_path: Successful session validation queues only an in-memory timestamp for persisted session hashes.
Repeated validations for the same session inside the defer window are ignored.
No DB UPDATE or COMMIT is issued by middleware for last_seen.
flush_path: Background worker flushes pending last_seen timestamps periodically.
Force flush is available for shutdown/tests.
Batch update skips invalidated or expired sessions and skips rows whose last_seen_at is already newer.

validation_contract.validate_session: read-only DB path; returns AuthenticatedSession or raises InvalidSessionError
validation_contract.last_seen_update: explicit deferred queue outside validation functions
